## AML Screening Framework  
### Screening Lists & Sources  
**Mandatory Screening Databases:**  
| List | Authority | Frequency | Purpose |
|------|-----------|-----------|---------|
| OFAC Sanctions List | US Treasury | Daily | Sanction compliance |
| EU Consolidated List | European Commission | Daily | EU sanctions |
| HMT Sanctions List | UK Treasury | Daily | UK sanctions |
| UN Sanctions List | UN Security Council | Weekly | UN terrorism sanctions |
| PEP Database | Third-party provider | Real-time | Politically Exposed Persons |
| Adverse Media | Third-party provider | Real-time | Criminal/fraud records |
name: Chunk 7/35

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Framework
raw_entities.description: The bank's formal policy governing anti-money laundering screening obligations, including mandatory screening against sanctions lists, PEP databases, and adverse media sources. The framework specifies screening databases, authorities, and update frequencies to ensure compliance with sanctions and financial crime prevention requirements.
context: AML Screening Framework
Mandatory Screening Databases

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Screening Against OFAC Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen all customers and transactions against the OFAC Sanctions List maintained by the US Treasury on a daily basis to ensure compliance with US sanctions regulations.
context: OFAC Sanctions List | US Treasury | Daily | Sanction compliance

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Screening Against EU Consolidated List
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen all customers and transactions against the EU Consolidated List maintained by the European Commission on a daily basis to ensure compliance with EU sanctions regulations.
context: EU Consolidated List | European Commission | Daily | EU sanctions

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Screening Against HMT Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen all customers and transactions against the HMT Sanctions List maintained by the UK Treasury on a daily basis to ensure compliance with UK sanctions regulations.
context: HMT Sanctions List | UK Treasury | Daily | UK sanctions

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Screening Against UN Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen all customers and transactions against the UN Sanctions List maintained by the UN Security Council on a weekly basis to ensure compliance with UN terrorism sanctions.
context: UN Sanctions List | UN Security Council | Weekly | UN terrorism sanctions

raw_entities.name: Real-Time Screening Against PEP Database
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen all customers in real-time against a third-party PEP Database to identify and flag Politically Exposed Persons as part of enhanced due diligence obligations.
context: PEP Database | Third-party provider | Real-time | Politically Exposed Persons

raw_entities.name: Real-Time Screening Against Adverse Media
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen all customers in real-time against adverse media sources maintained by a third-party provider to identify criminal and fraud records.
context: Adverse Media | Third-party provider | Real-time | Criminal/fraud records

raw_entities.name: OFAC Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: The sanctions list maintained by the US Treasury identifying individuals, entities, and vessels subject to US sanctions. The bank must screen against this list daily for sanctions compliance.
context: OFAC Sanctions List | US Treasury | Daily | Sanction compliance

raw_entities.name: EU Consolidated List
raw_entities.description: The consolidated sanctions list maintained by the European Commission identifying individuals and entities subject to EU sanctions. The bank must screen against this list daily for EU sanctions compliance.
context: EU Consolidated List | European Commission | Daily | EU sanctions

raw_entities.name: HMT Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: The sanctions list maintained by the UK Treasury (HMT) identifying individuals and entities subject to UK sanctions. The bank must screen against this list daily for UK sanctions compliance.
context: HMT Sanctions List | UK Treasury | Daily | UK sanctions

raw_entities.name: UN Sanctions List
raw_entities.description: The sanctions list maintained by the UN Security Council identifying individuals and entities subject to UN terrorism sanctions. The bank must screen against this list weekly.
context: UN Sanctions List | UN Security Council | Weekly | UN terrorism sanctions

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Violation
raw_entities.description: The risk that the bank may inadvertently conduct business with sanctioned individuals, entities, or vessels in violation of OFAC, EU, UK, or UN sanctions regulations. This risk is mitigated through daily screening against multiple sanctions lists.
context: OFAC Sanctions List | US Treasury | Daily | Sanction compliance
EU Consolidated List | European Commission | Daily | EU sanctions
HMT Sanctions List | UK Treasury | Daily | UK sanctions

raw_entities.name: Politically Exposed Person Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that the bank may fail to identify and apply enhanced due diligence to Politically Exposed Persons, who present elevated money laundering and corruption risks. This risk is mitigated through real-time screening against a PEP Database.
context: PEP Database | Third-party provider | Real-time | Politically Exposed Persons

raw_entities.name: Criminal and Fraud Record Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that the bank may conduct business with individuals or entities with known criminal or fraud histories. This risk is mitigated through real-time screening against adverse media sources.
context: Adverse Media | Third-party provider | Real-time | Criminal/fraud records
